description: n512 B640 GOOD (well-conditioned) subset, the 51% qr_panel_apply_fused trailing update currently runs FP16 + needs FP32 reortho cleanup. Forking off the brief-4 best (which proved cuBLAS-13 BF16x9 FP32-emulation is bit-FP32-exact and leaderboard-portable on this kernel): route the n512 GOOD-subset trailing block-reflector GEMMs (V^T C, V(T^T W)) through BF16x9 emulation instead of FP16. BF16x9 is FP32-exact, so this should match accuracy WITHOUT the FP16 path's fixup passes (classify_convert 5.4%, fill_R_zero_tail 2.8%) while still using tensor cores. Compare BF16x9 vs the current FP16+cleanup end-to-end on shape 3.

RE-BASELINE to clean remote-valid 769f6f8b9: reverted the brief-4 bad-subset BF16x9 (g_prec_emul off the bad path, nlev 3->2, bad-subset OB128/IB64->64/32) so the branch differs from the clean baseline ONLY by the good-subset change. With _N512_GOOD_EMUL=1 (this commit) the n512 dense GOOD subset takes the FP32-storage BF16x9 path (raw panel W8/OB64/IB16): geomean 1732.7us, shape3 6280us. With _N512_GOOD_EMUL=0 the SAME branch reproduces the clean baseline FP16 good path EXACTLY: geomean 1636.1us, shape3 3165us (matches coordinator's ~1639us). So the BF16x9 good-subset route is FP32-EXACT (validate PASS, scaled_factor_residual<=0.13 on all n512 tests, comfortable margin) but REGRESSES shape3 ~2x: nsys shows the FP32 raw panel is 25.6% (ncu: latency-bound, 47% occ, <1 wave) + build_Minv 8.6% + build_V 3.5% + wasted classify_convert 2.9%; the BF16x9 trailing GEMMs themselves are efficient. The regression is the loss of the FP16 path's panel-apply FUSION (qr_panel_apply_fused) + FP16-storage bandwidth, which dwarfs the ~8% cleanup (classify_convert+fill_R) BF16x9 drops.

HEAD set to _N512_GOOD_EMUL=0: the clean remote-VALID baseline 769f6f8b9 equivalent (geomean 1637.5us, shape3 3159us FP16 path, shape7 5077us SIMT bad subset). The branch now differs from the clean baseline ONLY by inert dead code (the BF16x9 good-subset machinery, disabled) -- directly submittable for a real remote verdict with comfortable gate margin (validate PASS, all n512 scaled_factor_residual<=0.13). The BF16x9 good-subset route itself (trial 6, geomean 1733us) is FP32-exact but regresses shape3 ~2x and is kept off. NOTE this 1637.5us is SLOWER than the parent's remote-INVALID 1619us because reverting the brief-4 bad-subset BF16x9 (which gave shape7 4537->5077us) was required for remote validity.

PIVOT (coordinator redirect): bad-subset BF16x9 with REMOTE-SAFE conservative knobs. geomean 1626.2us = +0.7% over the clean remote-valid baseline (1637.5us), shape7(mixed) 4751us vs SIMT 5077us. The good subset stays FP16 (BF16x9-good is dead). KEY MEASUREMENT (diagnostic split_bad_min=8, B=16 homogeneous routed through the bad path): BF16x9 bad-subset factor-residual on the gate-classes = band 0.017, rowscale 0.038, nearcollinear 0.019 (scaled, gate=20) -- BIT-IDENTICAL to SIMT-FP32 (0.016/0.044/0.025), ALL ~1000x under the gate. So BF16x9 is FP32-EXACT and COMFORTABLE-margin on the bad subset, NOT a gate-rider (the documented 19.3/20 is the small-batch TF32 _qr_exact_2level path, already routed to geqrf). This config differs from the remote-FAILED brief-4 ONLY by reverting brief-4's OB128/IB64+nlev=3 to the board-accepted OB64/IB32+nlev=2 (special-values NONE is required for the speedup: DEFAULT made BF16x9 SLOWER than SIMT, trial 8 shape7 5825). Validate PASS + diff_correctness/invariance/offgrid guards ALL CLEAN. OPEN QUESTION for remote verdict: if brief-4 failed on the BF16x9+special-values-NONE MATH (not its blocking), this fails too; if it failed on the OB128/IB64+nlev=3 blocking, this is safe. Needs a remote submission to disambiguate. Also profiled good-subset BF16x9 dead end (trials 1-6): regresses shape3 2x (FP32 panel latency-bound).

BF16x9 ABANDONED (remote verdict: both brief-4 and my trial-9 FAILED the remote test stage -- BF16x9 emulation math is not FP32-exact on the remote toolchain, confirmed NOT a build error/blocking/margin issue). Pivoted to non-BF16x9 remote-safe levers for the n512-mixed bad subset. MEASURED (split_bad_min=8 diagnostic): TF32 trailing FAILS validate (band/rowscale cross gate); hybrid exact-W + TF32-final-update rides the gate on band/rowscale (15.9/15.1 of 20, <1.3x margin) -- both TF32 variants remote-UNSAFE. So the bad-subset trailing must stay SIMT-FP32-exact. The remote-safe lever is BLOCKING: wider OB128/IB64 (trial 10) recovers shape7 5077->4928 (geomean 1631.6, +0.36% vs clean baseline, pure SIMT-FP32, all guards CLEAN). This trial (OB128/IB32) = 5141/1642 (worse); OB256/IB64 FAILS guards. OB128/IB64 (trial 10, commit 643d172a) is the best remote-safe candidate. Bad-subset trailing on tensor cores is blocked: TF32 rides the gate, BF16x9 is remote-broken.

SIMT bad path + OB128/IB64 + nlev=3: geomean 1631.0us, shape7 4921us. nlev=3 (vs nlev=2 trial 10) is ~noise (build_Minv ~4.7% is not the bottleneck at this blocking). Best remote-safe config = SIMT-FP32 bad path + wider OB128/IB64 blocking, +0.4% over clean baseline (1637.5), pure stock cuBLAS (no BF16x9, no TF32) -> remote-portable. All 3 guards CLEAN. The bad-subset trailing CANNOT go to tensor cores safely: BF16x9 remote-broken (verdict-confirmed), TF32 rides the gate on band/rowscale (15-16/20). Remaining shape7 cost = SIMT sgemm ~17.5% (CUDA-core, can't accelerate safely) + FP32 cmf panel ~15.7% (single-CTA/matrix, latency-bound -- the 'more CTAs'/warp-spec fix is brief-5/7 territory).

Bad-subset panel occupancy lever: swapped the cmf panel (32-warp, warp-specialized, 1 CTA/SM) for the raw-V panel (8-warp, more CTAs/SM to fill the work-starved ~96-CTA grid). Result: SLOWER -- shape7 6027us, geomean 1660 (vs cmf trial-12 4921/1631). The cmf panel's intra-CTA warp-specialization (warp0 runs the serial reflector chain while 31 bulk warps apply to trailing cols) hides the per-column barrier latency better than raw's 8-warp deferred-scale; raw's extra CTAs/SM do not compensate for its lower per-CTA parallelism. So the 'more CTAs (per SM)' mechanism does NOT help the cmf panel -- cmf is already the right structure. Note the cmf panel canNOT be split across MULTIPLE CTAs/matrix (the per-column __syncthreads barrier couples the serial reflector chain to the apply -- cross-CTA sync per column is infeasible). All guards CLEAN. Best remains trial 12 (cmf, SIMT, OB128/IB64, 1631us).

FINAL HEAD: best remote-safe config = bad subset SIMT-FP32 cmf panel + wider OB128/IB64 + nlev=3, good subset FP16 (BF16x9 fully off). geomean 1631.6us = +0.4% over clean baseline (1637.5), shape7 4916us (was 5077 SIMT-OB64/IB32). Pure stock cuBLAS, remote-portable, all guards CLEAN. EXHAUSTED bad-subset levers this brief: (a) BF16x9 trailing -- comfortable margin locally (~0.02, 1000x) but remote test FAILED (verdict 843979, emulation not FP32-exact remotely); (b) TF32 trailing -- rides gate (band/rowscale 15-16/20), validation FAILS; (c) hybrid exact-W+TF32-final -- rides gate (15.9/15.1); (d) blocking OB128/IB64 best valid (OB256 fails guards, OB128/IB32 worse); (e) nlev neutral; (f) raw-V panel (more CTAs/SM) SLOWER than cmf. The bad-subset cmf panel CANNOT be split across multiple CTAs/matrix (per-column __syncthreads couples the serial reflector chain to the apply). OPEN for the manager: the SIMT sgemm (~15.7%) + cmf panel (~16%) remain the irreducible bad-subset cost with no safe tensor-core path; a stock-portable cross-CTA cooperative panel (cooperative_groups grid sync) is the only untried 'more CTAs/matrix' route.

BRIEF-6 (n512 GOOD-subset BF16x9) -> pivoted under coordinator redirects to the n512 BAD-subset (shape7). 14 trials. BEST REMOTE-SAFE DELIVERABLE: HEAD commit 385c973c, geomean 1631.6us = +0.4% over the clean remote-valid baseline (1637.5us), shape7 5077->4916us. Config: bad subset SIMT-FP32 (cmf panel) + WIDER blocking OB128/IB64 + nlev=3; good subset FP16. PURE stock cuBLAS -- no BF16x9, no TF32, no emulation -> remote-portable. Validate PASS + diff_correctness/invariance/offgrid guards ALL CLEAN. Submit 385c973c for the verdict.

MEASURED DEAD ENDS (all built+benchmarked): (1) the ORIGINAL brief -- BF16x9 on the n512 GOOD subset: regresses shape3 ~2x (3165->6280us); the FP32-storage path loses the FP16 fused panel-apply + FP16 bandwidth, and ncu shows the FP32 raw panel is latency-bound (47% occ, <1 wave); the ~8% cleanup BF16x9 drops is dwarfed. (2) BF16x9 on the bad subset: comfortable margin LOCALLY (band/rowscale/nearcollinear 0.017/0.038/0.019 scaled, ~1000x under gate 20) but remote test FAILED (verdict 843979 -- the emulation is NOT FP32-exact on the remote toolchain; confirmed by your 76s-runtime test-stage failure, not a build error). (3) TF32 trailing: rides the gate (band/rowscale cross 20), validation FAILS. (4) Hybrid exact-W + TF32-final-update: rides the gate (band 15.9, rowscale 15.1 of 20, <1.3x). (5) Bad-subset raw-V panel (more CTAs/SM): SLOWER than cmf (6027 vs 4916) -- cmf's intra-CTA warp-specialization beats raw's occupancy. (6) OB256/IB64 blocking: FAILS guards (correctness bug). (7) nlev: neutral.

KEY FINDING: the n512-mixed bad-subset TRAILING cannot use tensor cores by ANY safe path -- BF16x9 is remote-broken, TF32 rides the gate. It must stay SIMT-FP32. The remaining bad-subset cost (shape7) is SIMT sgemm ~15.7% + FP32 cmf panel ~16%, both irreducible without a tensor-core path or a multi-CTA-per-matrix panel.

OPEN DIRECTIONS for the manager (NOT pursued -- flagged to avoid duplicating brief-5/7 or gate-riding): (a) a stock-portable MULTI-CTA-per-matrix bad-subset panel via cooperative_groups grid sync (the only untried 'more CTAs/matrix' route -- the cmf panel's per-column __syncthreads currently blocks a 2-CTA/matrix split); (b) whether the FP16 GOOD rank-reveal path on shapes 9/10 (rankdef/clustered) -- which I measured at scaled_factor_residual ~16.5/13.8, within 1.2-1.5x of the gate -- is itself a remote-fragility worth hardening (it passed remotely in the baseline, but the margin is thin); (c) a NON-precision speedup of the SIMT sgemm trailing (it is the largest single bad-subset cost). The good-subset BF16x9 machinery and the bad-subset BF16x9/TF32 selectors remain in the file as DISABLED flag branches (each measured) -- a simplify pass could strip them now that BF16x9 is verdict-confirmed remote-dead.
